description: Evolve F1 rear wing for maximum performance. Optimize downforce, drag, and lap time for specified circuit.

solution_format.description: JSON file with F1 rear wing parameters

constraints.flap_angle: 8-18 degrees (CRITICAL: high angles stall, 25°+ has terrible L/D)
constraints.flap_gap: 0.02-0.04 (2-4% chord is optimal for slot effect)

optimization_strategies.name: reduce_flap_angle
optimization_strategies.description: Lower flap angle to avoid stall
optimization_strategies.hint: Physics shows 25° flap stalls badly (L/D=2). Try 10-15° for L/D >20. This is the biggest lever!

optimization_strategies.name: optimize_main_angle
optimization_strategies.description: Fine-tune main element angle of attack
optimization_strategies.hint: 10-12° gives best L/D. Above 15° drag increases rapidly.

optimization_strategies.name: slot_gap_tuning
optimization_strategies.description: Optimize gap between main element and flap
optimization_strategies.hint: 2-4% chord is optimal. Gap energizes boundary layer and delays separation.

optimization_strategies.name: camber_optimization
optimization_strategies.description: Adjust CST coefficients for optimal camber
optimization_strategies.hint: Higher upper coefficients = more camber = more lift, but watch for stall.

optimization_strategies.name: balance_elements
optimization_strategies.hint: Main element should do most lifting. Flap extends lift without killing L/D.

physics_background.downforce: F1 wings generate 2-3x car weight in downforce at speed. Cl typically 1.5-2.5
physics_background.drag: Rear wing is ~30% of total drag. Cd typically 0.3-0.7
physics_background.efficiency: Teams optimize Cl²/Cd for overall performance
physics_background.regulations: FIA limits dimensions and materials. Wings tested for flexibility.
physics_background.DRS: Drag Reduction System opens flap to reduce drag by ~20% on straights

circuit_profiles.monaco: Maximum downforce - tight corners, low speed, grip is everything
circuit_profiles.monza: Minimum drag - long straights, top speed critical
circuit_profiles.silverstone: Balanced - high-speed corners need downforce, straights need efficiency
circuit_profiles.spa: Power circuit - Eau Rouge/Raidillon need downforce, but Kemmel straight matters
circuit_profiles.suzuka: Technical - 130R and Spoon need grip, figure-8 layout rewards balance
